title: Freshly qualify offline source-free Math analysis and scientific NuGet consumers
commitMessage: docs: qualify fresh offline Math NuGet consumers without publication

contribution.summary: Freshly qualify two current-source Math preview NuGet packages through their existing independent offline source-free consumer applications. Rebuild and locally repack analysis and scientific, restore clients solely from separate local feeds into an isolated NuGet cache, and require all sixteen historical boundary probes to succeed again. Keep the completed M0-M7 DWF plan unchanged and publish nothing.

The existing clients inspect their current archive bytes and report SHA-256, size and eight verified probes each. One BCL checker validates nine successful local commands, two consumers and sixteen probes; external adoption, generated Discovery, broad ABI and public release remain unclaimed.
